properties.title: Monkey Central Market
properties.description: Vibrant local marketplace with fresh bananas, vintage goods, and tech spares.
properties.monkeyNote: GO! loves climbing the market stalls; Couchmonkey recommends the fruit smoothie stand.

properties.title: Retro Garage & Sound Lab
properties.description: Restoration workshop for classic hardware, modular synths, and vehicle diagnostics.
properties.monkeyNote: K.I.T.T. sensors align perfectly here; look for vintage vacuum tubes.

properties.title: Free Monkeys Dev Hub
properties.description: Open hacker lounge with local server racks, beanbags, and high-speed loopback Wi-Fi.
properties.monkeyNote: Home base for Couchmonkey and MI Companion. Great coffee spot.

properties.title: Sunbeam Monkey Park
properties.description: Lush green urban oasis with mature oak trees, sunny benches, and a small duck pond.
properties.monkeyNote: Ideal running track for GO! to set a new 60-second dash record.

properties.title: Skyline Telemetry Tower
properties.description: Historic radio tower offering high altitude observation across the city.
properties.monkeyNote: MI Companion reports 100% signal coverage from the upper observation tier.

properties.title: The Golden Banana Café
properties.description: Artsy café serving specialty banana bread, cold brew espresso, and organic teas.
properties.monkeyNote: Couchmonkey has a reserved velvet armchair in the corner.
